module: Container of a rally's transcriptions (recognized text of the co-driver's voice during the recce). It loads and saves a JSON file, and manages a `sortedList` of entries (transcripts/entry.lua). It also provides the unique identifiers and the debug drawing of the transcriptions. The module returns a constructor: `require(...)(fname)`.
notes: The big comment above drawDebugTranscripts is commented-out test code (quaternion rotation): it is not executed.
_draw_debug_hover_tsc_id is never modified in this file; only the nil value is used.

C.desc: Transcriptions path. Fields: fname, selection_sphere_r (4), _draw_debug_hover_tsc_id, transcripts (sortedList of entries).

getNextUniqueIdentifier.desc: Returns an increasing integer (1, 2, 3…) used as the entries' id.

init.desc: Constructor: stores the file name and creates the `transcripts` sortedList.

load.desc: Loads the JSON file (jsonReadFile) and deserializes. Logs a warning and returns false if fname is nil or the file is absent, an error if reading fails.

save.desc: Serializes and writes the JSON file (jsonWriteFile with the compact parameter set to false).

onDeserialized.desc: Empties the list and reloads it from data.transcripts. Does nothing if data is nil.

drawDebug.desc: Entry point of the debug drawing; calls drawDebugTranscripts.

drawDebugTranscripts.desc: Calls drawDebug(is_hovered, is_selected) on each entry of the sorted list.
